Both plain and underscore symbol aliases are exported; ELF non-executable stack and conditional CET landing marker are present.

Hash-many handles batches8 then remainder bits4/2/1 without external fallback. Each input produces32 bytes: eight-way stores256, four-way128, two-way64 and one-way32. Smaller paths still require AVX2; XMM width is not a portable fallback.

Eight-way counters add masked offsets0..7 and masked step8, with low32 unsigned carry implemented by sign-bit xor and signed comparison; smaller groups select remaining counter lanes. Counter increment is controlled by mask derived from increment_counter.

Full-block loops advance byte offset64 before equality check against blocks shifted6. First/start flags and final/end flags are combined around that comparison. Positive block count and representable block-byte length are caller preconditions; zero blocks with nonzero inputs are not handled as an empty-message shortcut.

Four/two-way paths load32 bytes at offsets ending -0x10 then insert128 halves from another input; this can read16 bytes beyond the current64-byte block on the first input of each pair. Source establishes wider reads, not a reproduced fault: padded allocation and caller contracts require separate investigation.

Unaligned external loads/stores coexist with aligned stack/constants. Prefetches advance beyond current block. Seven-round tail loops permute message words; eight-way core is unrolled. No runtime correctness or speed is inferred from source similarity.
